updatePolicy.weeklyReview: Fetch upstream stable, main and nightly changes; recommend individual changes to take, defer or skip for user selection.
updatePolicy.integration: Integrate selected changes into custom stable, preserving custom behavior and existing phone/desktop compatibility.
updatePolicy.channelChanges: No nightly switch or stable-base upgrade is planned or authorized by the weekly review.

contracts.name: linked environments
contracts.requirement: Linked T3 servers exchange worker traffic over tailnet-only HTTPS (POST /api/peer/v1, bearer token issued by the peer, caller must be a configured peer). t3_session_send and t3_worker_spawn accept environment; remote messages and reports are queued, retried every 30 s while the peer is offline, and delivered idempotently; masters list/read/send/wait/control remote workers through their own server; reports follow a handoff successor. Links are created by t3w peer link and stored in each server's peer-environments secret.
contracts.status: active on sliara and myalien in custom stable .25

contracts.name: orchestrator succession and profile controls
contracts.requirement: Authenticated masters can transfer directly owned workers to a new base-forked, self-forked or fresh successor, with an explicit destination account/model/effort. Queue self-forks until source turn ends; preserve assignments and read cursors; reroute undelivered and future reports atomically; retain idempotent retries and cancellation. Agents can generate validated worker profile changes without mutating sessions.
contracts.status: active on sliara and myalien in custom stable .24

contracts.name: fresh managed sessions
contracts.requirement: Create a managed worker without a fork source, using the selected project and account/model profile and the master's permission/interaction modes. Preserve ownership, durable assignments, retries, reporting, and follow-ups for both fresh and forked workers.
contracts.status: active on sliara and myalien in custom stable .24

contracts.name: prepared base forks
contracts.requirement: Fork native and visible conversation history from the selected idle account base, preserving context and source; custom naming and fixed effort are external workflow configuration.
contracts.upstreamDisposition: Verify native fork equivalence before retiring custom implementation.

contracts.name: persistent workers
contracts.requirement: Persist master ownership separately from fork source; list/read/send/wait/control; durable queues and bounded incremental reads; follow up in the same worker.
contracts.upstreamDisposition: Upstream delegate_task creates prompt-only children and is not automatically equivalent to prepared-base fork ownership.

contracts.name: worker reports
contracts.requirement: Workers explicitly report assignment done or genuinely blocked through authenticated t3_worker_report; turn endings/progress/restarts alone do not notify. Preserve direct-input ownership, durable deduplicated reports, and disabled notifications. Runtime failures/input requests remain automatic. Masters review latest output/evidence and give an actionable disposition without acknowledgment chatter.
contracts.upstreamDisposition: Audit native/app-owned task reporting separately from custom forked workers.

contracts.name: intentional worker account changes
contracts.requirement: Validate settings at send time; explicit adoption or master-controlled account/model change updates saved profile; preserve permissions and ownership; do not replay failed prompts.

contracts.name: mid-chat account/provider switching
contracts.requirement: Preserve conversation, transfer compatible cursors safely, otherwise bounded handoff with history access; queue changes until current turn ends.

contracts.name: Codex health probes
contracts.requirement: Successful provider status must survive probe cleanup; avoid false timeout/unavailable reports.

integrationRequirements: Existing conversations and data remain intact
All installed account profiles remain available
Preserve compatibility with the existing Android app and Windows desktop
Real base fork and master-worker round trips pass
Existing workers retain ownership and reporting

changes.reason: Fixes V2 delegated-task/run recovery. This build retains protocol 1 and custom WorkerControls, whose restart/report persistence tests pass. Stable startup reconciliation preserves stop/continuation semantics; V2 is not enabled.
Fixes V2 queued runs and preparation-time metadata races. Stable gates sends until worktree handoff and serializes worktree commands through workspace leases. Does not add the V2 setup-time queue UI.

Targeted lint passes with existing warnings
Protocol 1 startup with 234-thread isolated snapshot; replay jobs removed and providers disabled in the copy
Real Linux systemd scope and oom_score_adj=800 launch
limitations: No browser/computer-use or Android-device validation performed
Native Android Stop UI is not part of this server/web backport
Prepared-base worker behavior covered by regression tests; no new live worker assignments issued for validation
